data.long_description:
READY TO MOVE IN | PRIME WATERFRONT LOCATION | SPACIOUS 1 BEDROOM

Apartment for Rent in Dubai Creek Residences South Tower 1, Dubai Creek Harbour

Experience waterfront living in this spacious 1-bedroom apartment located in the prestigious Dubai Creek Residences South. Situated in one of Dubai Creek Harbour's most sought-after communities, this well-maintained home offers comfort, convenience, and stunning surroundings.

Property Features:
- 1 Bedroom
- 2 Bathrooms
- Unfurnished
- Fully Equipped Kitchen
- Built-in Wardrobes & Walk-in Closet
- Laundry Area with Washing Machine
- Bright and Spacious Layout
- Ready to Move In

Community Amenities:
- Swimming Pool
- Fully Equipped Gym
- Children's Play Area
- Waterfront Promenade
- 24/7 Security
- Covered Parking

Enjoy a vibrant lifestyle with easy access to restaurants, retail outlets, walking tracks, and breathtaking views of Dubai Creek. Perfect for professionals or couples seeking a premium waterfront address in a prime location.

Contact us today to arrange a viewing.
